canonical_project: NIRS Daejeon main center (National Information Resources Service)
owner: NIRS / Ministry of Interior and Safety (government)
notes: Flagship government datacenter (Gukjeong Jawon) in Daejeon Yuseong-gu; hosts core government digital services. Major lithium-battery fire 2025-09-26 during UPS replacement on 5F server floor; ~647 government services disrupted; recovery ongoing. Public-sector DC, not commercial colo.
